rgpd.serveur: This option is used in a server: your data is stored per server.
rgpd.export_ok: Here is your data on this server (JSON file). Only you can see this message.
rgpd.question:
Erase **your data** on this server?
• **Erased**: profile, bio, birthday, inventory, reputation received, wallet history, statistics, giveaway entries…
• **Anonymised**: your ID is removed from items that are used by others (tickets, giveaways, announcements, games, sanctions you issued).
• **Reset**: balance set to 0, XP brought back to the threshold of your level, job back to level 1.
• **Kept** (anti-abuse footprint, no content, so that erasing cannot be used to replay rewards): any account freeze, date of your last daily, achievements already earned, level reached, quests and daily games of today and yesterday, daily limits.
• **Also kept**: sanctions you received (2 years), any temporary ban in progress and your ticket anti-spam delay (10 min).
This cannot be undone (only recent backups, up to 7 days, still contain this data).
rgpd.temps: Time is up, nothing was erased.
rgpd.ok: Your data on this server has been processed: {resume}.
rgpd.gele: Your account is frozen by the staff: your wallet (balance and history) cannot be erased while the freeze lasts. Everything else is erased; run the command again once unfrozen to erase the wallet.
rgpd.cooldown: You already erased your data less than an hour ago. Try again in {minutes} min.
rgpd.echec: Erasure failed: nothing was changed (the operation is rolled back as a whole). Try again later.
